question: Can the completed p67 native integration bind to exact .036 firmware without borrowing addresses from .043?
prototype_hypothesis: The two p67 builds preserve the generic native GAP/CoC, ferry and QuickJS contracts, with independently measured addresses and identical audited structure layouts.
control_flow_evidence: Framework getter 0xC8E6C70 reads singleton 0x20138D30; FrameworkExt factory 0xC8CCCB4 locks impl+348 and manages app vector +460/+464.
Framework vtable 0x2CD7D618 and Application vtable 0x2CD7C5C0 include exact 15/52 words including two Itanium prefixes; factory slot 8 and init slot 2 match the native wrapper.
Application init 0xC8C2A00 and AIOTJS manager construction 0xC8F8B0E establish app+100 -> runtime+164 -> manager+4 registration and the already initialized 112-byte async at manager+60.
All six direct QuickJS entries have complete 48-byte identical instruction prefixes to their reviewed .043 counterparts.
Pipe table 0x2CC9910C was reconstructed from its exact ten Thumb handlers; no data address was inherited from .043.
ownership_analysis: Original SDU ownership, callback queue cancellation, native Feature instance lifetime, async close and retained pipe-file wake use the same measured contracts as .043.
unsafe_assumptions: No device execution, radio test or production approval is asserted for .036.
Structure layouts are accepted only where exact .036 instructions independently establish them.
recommended_probe: Build exact .036, activate on its isolated device, require the Feature and execute the native lifecycle probe before any radio claim.
